source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 11.11.1 with the Reduction subsection, printed pages 268-269.

blocks.text: Organic compounds ki oxygen ke saath reaction wali oxidation aam taur par combustion (jalna) hoti hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne ethane ki combustion C₂H₆ + 2O₂ → 2CO₂ + 3H₂ chhapi hai. Yeh balanced nahi aur product bhi ghalat hai: jalne se pani (H₂O) banta hai, hydrogen gas nahi. Sahi equation C₂H₆ + 7/2 O₂ → 2CO₂ + 3H₂O hai (dono taraf 2 C, 6 H aur 7 O).
Organic compounds ki oxidizing agents ke saath reactions, maslan:
i) Ozonolysis ozone (O₃) se alkenes ko oxidation ke zariye kaatne ka tareeqa hai.

blocks.alt: 1-Propene H3C-CH=CH2 O3 ke saath ozonide ring (halqa) deti hai; Zn/H2O se acetaldehyde (H3C-CHO) + formaldehyde (HCHO), jo reduce ho kar ethanol H3C-CH2-OH aur methanol CH3-OH bante hain.
blocks.caption: i) Propene ki ozonolysis (kitab ke page 268 par chhape diagram jaisi original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Acetaldehyde aur formaldehyde ethanal aur methanal ke purane (common) naam hain.
ii) Alkene ki epoxidation bhi oxidation reaction ki misal hai. Is mein oxygen molecule aur metal catalysts jaise different (alag alag) oxidizing agents istemal ho sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Alkene (H2C=CH2) + O2 se epoxide (do carbons aur ek O ka three-membered ring), jo H+/H2O ke saath ethane-1,2-diol deta hai.
blocks.caption: ii) Alkene ki epoxidation (kitab ke page 268 par chhape diagram jaisi original drawing).

blocks.text: iv) Primary alcohols acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ (acid mila potassium dichromate) se react kar ke carboxylic acids banate hain; is ki tafseel class 12 mein parhenge.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: [O] ka matlab hai oxidizing agent se milne wali oxygen, aur [H] ka matlab reducing agent se milne wali hydrogen. In ko equation mein aise likhte hain taake asal reagent ka poora formula likhna na pare.
